description.value:
Granted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3mINzPzup2m9qzFU]{Sepulchral Mask}

You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saving throws against emotion effects.

Your funerary mask emanates a 5-foot aura (10 feet at 3rd rank, 15 feet at 5th, and so on). During an encounter, at the start of each enemy's turn in the emanation, a card is posted with a button for you to roll the mental damage and one for its Will save against your spell DC. Once both are rolled, the result is applied: the damage for its degree of success, and on a failure the –1 status penalty to Will saves against emotion effects (@UUID[Compendium.evan-character-homebrew.evans-character-homebrew.Item.GOsDZYg9DXFPhzwg]{Effect: Sepulchral Mask}) for 1 round, or 1 minute on a critical failure. Creatures immune to mental or visual effects, including blinded ones, are unaffected.

Enemies in the area when you Cast the Spell roll from the spell's card as usual, and failed saves get the penalty too.

Casting the spell applies this aura automatically on pf2e 8.x. On earlier versions, drag the spell effect from the spell's card onto yourself: the system's Spell Effect: Sepulchral Mask becomes this aura.
